name: brain-loop
notes: Turn recorded evidence into a persona that improves each round: gather → synthesize ⇄ grade → a person reviews → done.

nodes.task:
{goal}

Round {round}. Gather: bring every new source into the corpus and extract evidence from it. When done, claim with the counts and the paths you produced.

{goal}

Round {round}. Grade the persona in {prev_artifacts} against the exemplar sources and the ratings. Say `win` if it would pass someone who knows the subject well, otherwise `fail` with exactly what falls short. Do not edit the files.
